title: Hydration and rest for outdoor work in heat
text: General guidance for hot outdoor work: drink water regularly before thirst, about one cup every 15 to 20 minutes during heavy work in heat, and do not drink more than about 1.5 litres per hour. Water is enough for a normal shift; for long shifts with heavy sweating, add an electrolyte drink or food with salt, unless a doctor has restricted salt. Take rest breaks in real shade or air conditioning, not in a hot cab or against a wall. Watch the newest and the returning workers most closely, and use a buddy system so no one works alone in extreme heat.
source: US CDC NIOSH Heat Stress; OSHA-NIOSH Heat Safety Tool; ACGIH 2017
